event.description:
DATE: May 2nd 2026

Location:
Santa Clara Convention Center
5001 Great America Pkwy
Santa Clara, CA 95054

Cost: $35 entry
Registration Time: 9:00am - 10:45am
Start Time: 11:00am

Participation Prizing:
Metal Token, Badge, Sapphire Pack, Event Pack, and Grand Archive Regional Sleeves(While supplies last)

Top Placement Prizing:
1st- 36 RDO Booster Packs/6 RDO Event Pack
2nd- 24 RDO Booster Packs/4 RDO Event Packs
3rd- 24 RDO Booster Packs/4 RDO Event Packs
4th- 24 RDO Booster Packs/4 RDO Event Packs
5th- 18 RDO Booster Packs/4 RDO Event Packs
6th- 18 RDO Booster Packs/4 RDO Event Packs
7th- 18 RDO Booster Packs/4 RDO Event Packs
8th- 18 RDO Booster Packs/4 RDO Event Packs
9th- 12 RDO Booster Packs/4 RDO Event Packs
10th- 12 RDO Booster Packs/4 RDO  Event Packs
11th- 12 RDO Booster Packs/4 RDO Event Packs
12th- 12 RDO Booster Packs/4 RDO Event Packs
13th- 8 RDO Booster Packs/4 RDO Event Packs
14th- 8 RDO Booster Packs/4 RDO Event Packs
15th- 8 RDO Booster Packs/4 RDO Event Packs
16th- 8 RDO Booster Packs/4 RDO Event Packs

*Sapphire Packs will be added to top prizing based on how many are left over after the participation prizes are given out!

*Regional Invite Cards awarded to top 16!

Lunch Break- 45 Minute after round 3

Parking is free if you park in the parking Garage(as long as some sort of big event in the Stadium did not decide to pop up), 3rd floor gets into the convention center. You have to go down the escalator once inside, go to the other side of the convention center and go back up the other escalator.

Tickets will be Non Refundable once the event has started. You must show up in person to receive your entry prizing.
